Problem Statement
Traditional keyword-based search systems often fail to understand the semantic meaning
of user queries. As document collections continue to grow, manually searching through
hundreds of pages becomes inefficient and time-consuming.
Although Large Language Models provide impressive conversational abilities, they
cannot guarantee that every generated answer is factually correct.
Without external
knowledge retrieval, these models may generate misleading information or respond using
outdated knowledge.
Therefore, there is a need for an intelligent system capable of:
• Understanding natural language queries.
• Searching uploaded documents semantically.
• Generating answers only from available evidence.
• Providing source citations for verification.
• Protecting user privacy by running the language model locally.
The proposed Intelligent Research Assistant addresses these challenges through Retrieval-
Augmented Generation.
